simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֱלִיעָם (H463) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֱלִיעָם (ʼĔlîyʻâm) means Eliam , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 2Sam 11 3.

definitions.full: H463. Eliam אֱלִיעָם proper name, masculine ( God is kinsman ; < = El is kinsman (see Gray Ency. Bib. AMMI, NAMES WITH Nö ib. NAMES, § 46 ) Phoenician אלעם ) a. father of Bathsheba 2Sam 11:3 ; compare עַמִּיאֵל 1Chr 3:5 . b. one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:34 (according to some = a ).
